name: The Darkness Within
source:
The Darkness Within is a modern fantasy Adult Visual Novel (AVN) that blends slow-burn romance with some elements of psychological horror. This is a deeply character-driven story where every major player has complex motivations, secrets, and a vital role to play in the looming, supernatural conflict.

Mike's life is defined by a crippling emotional numbness, punctuated by bouts of raw, uncontrolled anger. Haunted by strange dreams and a mother suspended somewhere beyond his reach, he takes a lifeline: an invitation from an old friend to visit the vibrant, liberal city of Freistadt.

Here, Mike begins to truly feel again, but this awakening comes with a devastating cost. During a fateful night at an art gallery, he accidentally realizes he can cross into The Realm of Darkness—a literal landscape of the human subconscious, and a place where fantastic creatures exist. 

Mike soon discovers he can harness the immense, volatile power he carries inside: his own raw emotion. By joining The Academy, he must learn to master his mind and battle the powerful beings who seek to control both worlds.

Join him through this dark and hopeful adventure, where he will cross paths with six compelling women—any one of whom could be the key to his own healing or his own destruction.

[From [url=https://misherumaxis.itch.io/the-darkness-within]itch.io[/url]]
